sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshījié kuài dào le.
sentences.english: Teachers' Day is approaching.

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shì gēge, Lìlì shì mèimei.
sentences.english: Xiaoming is the older brother, Lili is the younger sister.

sentences.pinyin: Zǎoshang, Xiǎomíng duì Lìlì shuō: “Jiàoshījié kuài dào le, wǒmen sòng shénme gěi lǎoshī ne?”
sentences.english: In the morning, Xiaoming said to Lili, “Teachers' Day is approaching, what should we give to the teacher?”

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiǎng le xiǎng, shuō: “Wǒ juéde kěyǐ sòng lǎoshī yī duǒ huā, hái yǒu yī zhāng kǎpiàn.”
sentences.english: Lili thought for a moment and said, “I think we can give the teacher a flower, and a card.”

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng gāoxìng de shuō: “Hǎo a! Wǒmen yīqǐ qù huāyuán zhāi huā, ránhòu zìjǐ zuò kǎpiàn ba!”
sentences.english: Xiaoming happily said, “Great! Let's go to the garden together to pick flowers, and then make cards ourselves!”

sentences.pinyin: Yúshì, liǎng ge rén yīqǐ lái dào huāyuán.
sentences.english: So, the two of them came to the garden together.

sentences.pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ de huā zhēn piàoliang!
sentences.english: The flowers in the garden are so beautiful!

sentences.pinyin: Yǒu hóngsè de, yǒu huángsè de, hái yǒu báisè de.
sentences.english: There are red ones, yellow ones, and white ones.

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì zhāi le hěn duō piàoliang de huā, Xiǎomíng zhāi le wǔ duǒ hóngsè de huā.
sentences.english: Lili picked many beautiful flowers, and Xiaoming picked five red flowers.

sentences.pinyin: Huí jiā de lùshang, tāmen mǎi le yī zhāng báizhǐ hé yī xiē cǎibǐ.
sentences.english: On the way home, they bought a white paper and some colored pens.

sentences.pinyin: Dào le jiā, tāmen kāishǐ yīqǐ zuò kǎpiàn.
sentences.english: When they arrived home, they started making cards together.

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng zài kǎpiàn shàng xiě: “Lǎoshī, xièxie nín! Nín měitiān jiāo wǒmen, hěn xīnkǔ, wǒmen dōu hěn ài nín.”
sentences.english: Xiaoming wrote on the card: “Teacher, thank you! You teach us every day, it's very hard, we all love you very much.”

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì zài kǎpiàn shàng huà le hěn duō huā, hái huà le yī ge xiàoliǎn.
sentences.english: Lili drew many flowers on the card, and also drew a smiling face.

sentences.pinyin: Dì èr tiān zǎoshang, tāmen ná zhe huā hé kǎpiàn qù xuéxiào.
sentences.english: The next morning, they took the flowers and cards to school.

sentences.pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhou, tāmen bǎ lǐwù sòng gěi le lǎoshī.
sentences.english: During class, they gave the gifts to the teacher.

sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī kàn dào kǎpiàn shàng xiě de zì, fēicháng gǎndòng.
sentences.english: The teacher was very touched when she saw the words written on the card.

sentences.pinyin: Tā duì Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì shuō: “Xièxie nǐmen, wǒ hěn xǐhuan zhè xiē lǐwù. Nǐmen zhēnshi hǎo háizi! Xīwàng nǐmen jìxù nǔlì xuéxí, yuè xué yuè hǎo.”
sentences.english: She said to Xiaoming and Lili, “Thank you, I really like these gifts. You are truly good children! I hope you continue to study hard and improve more and more.”

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì yīqǐ shuō: “Lǎoshī, wǒmen huì nǔlì de!”
sentences.english: Xiaoming and Lili said together, “Teacher, we will work hard!”

sentences.pinyin: Tīng dào tāmen de huà, lǎoshī kāixīn de xiào le.
sentences.english: Hearing their words, the teacher smiled happily.

sentences.pinyin: Huí jiā de lùshang, Lìlì duì Xiǎomíng shuō: “Gēge, jīntiān lǎoshī nàme gǎndòng, wǒ zhēnde hěn gāoxìng.”
sentences.english: On the way home, Lili said to Xiaoming, “Brother, the teacher was so touched today, I'm really happy.”

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: “Wǒ yě shì, lǎoshī měitiān dōu bāngzhù wǒmen, wǒmen yīnggāi xièxie tā.”
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, “Me too, the teacher helps us every day, we should thank her.”

sentences.pinyin: Tāmen dōu juéde hěn jiāo'ào, yě gèng ài tāmen de lǎoshī le.
sentences.english: They both felt very proud and loved their teacher even more.
